name: dt6 To Nifti Converter
summary: Converts a dtiInit dt6.mat tensor fit into NIfTI maps of FA, MD, AD, RD and the Westin shape indices (cl, cp, cs) with vistasoft.
description: Loads dti/dt6.mat from a dtiInit output, recomputes the eigen-decomposition and writes FA, MD, AD, RD, cl, cp and cs as NIfTI images in the tensor datatype. Use it when a dtiInit output must be used by Apps that take a tensor datatype. Format conversion utility; no model is refitted from the DWI.

outputs.description: Tensor datatype with FA, MD, AD, RD, cl, cp and cs NIfTI maps.

failure_modes.fix: Check that the input contains dti/dt6.mat.
